cancelled.description: True when the run terminated early via the cancellation token; counters reflect partial progress.

dlq_records.description: Records delivered to a DLQ destination during this scan.

dlq_records_by_type_and_class.description: DLQ deliveries keyed by `(destination sink type, failure class)`; empty when nothing was quarantined.

elapsed_ms.description: Milliseconds one scan took; on a summary folding several, the sum of their durations.

error_counts.description: Faulted probes tallied by fault kind; empty when no probe faulted.

first_probe_error.description: Kind and sample detail of the first probe that faulted; latched once per scan, absent when no probe faulted.

links_emitted.description: Topology links emitted on the second stream; `0` when no LLDP data was collected.

probes_by_kind.description: Per-probe-kind attempted / errored breakdown; empty when no probes ran.

profiles_emitted.description: Collection profiles emitted on the second stream; `0` when no gNMI capability data was collected.

sink_type.description: Concrete sink kind the scan wrote against.

unresolvable_targets.description:
Targets the network answered for with no addresses, as written in the scenario and in input
order; each was probed zero times. Empty when every target resolved.

ProbeErrorKind.description: The named reason a probe faulted, carried as data on the fault the outcome holds.

ProbeFault.description:
A typed probe fault carried on the outcome: the probe attempted a target and learned that
something broke, without discarding the signals it may have gathered on other ports.

RunAggregate.description:
The run's totals. `summary` folds every scenario's counters together, so its `elapsed_ms` is the
sum of the scenarios' durations rather than wall clock, and it attributes no `sink_type`.

ScenarioOutcome.description: How one scenario the run reached ended; `skipped` is a scenario that declared no probers and never ran.

scenario.description: The scenario's own name, or `unnamed` when it declared none.

summary.description: Absent when the scenario produced none: it was skipped, or it failed before the scan returned one.

ScenarioTally.description:
How many scenarios the run was asked for and how the ones it reached ended. `completed + failed +
skipped` is the fold over the report's entries, and falls short of `total` when the run was
cancelled before reaching the rest.

SinkErrorClass.description:
Bounded taxonomy of sink failure classes surfaced on `sink_errors_total` and `dlq_records_total`.

Each concrete sink tags its failures with one of these classes at the failure site, and the class
travels with the error rather than being re-derived from its message. The set grows as sinks are
added, so a document may carry a class a cached schema copy does not list.

SinkType.description: Concrete sink kind — surfaced on `dlq_records_total{sink_type}` and set on `DiscoverySummary`.

description: What one discovery run did: how every scenario it reached ended, and the run's totals.

report_version.description: Version of this document's shape. A consumer that does not recognise it cannot assume the field set.

scenarios.description:
One entry per scenario the run reached, in run order. Shorter than
`aggregate.scenario_counts.total` when the run was cancelled before reaching the rest.
